creator: nocturne
statement: Chaotic Amarok is the first Chaotic Boss and is located in World 1 in the Encroaching Forest Villas.

creator: nocturne
statement: Chaotic Amarok needs 875 Accuracy for a 5% hit chance and 2625 Accuracy for a 100% hit chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: He does significantly more damage so you need more Defense to survive.

creator: nocturne
statement: He recommends bringing plenty of food.

creator: nocturne
statement: He has 15 million HP so a significant amount of damage output is required to kill him.

creator: nocturne
statement: Chaotic Mode costs 5 Keys per attempt.

creator: nocturne
statement: Fireballs are telegraphed by red dots on the ground.

creator: nocturne
statement: Rocket Arm Punch is telegraphed so you can move out of the way to avoid damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: Stomp makes a line of spikes; on Chaotic spikes are summoned more frequently and cover more areas.

creator: nocturne
statement: Sword Swing hits the entire platform plus the spike area.

creator: nocturne
statement: In melee range on the top platform he enlarges his arm and uppercuts; basically a one-shot.

creator: nocturne
statement: Archers and Mages can fight on the top platform to avoid stomps.

creator: nocturne
statement: Melee classes should fight on the bottom platform.

creator: nocturne
statement: At 50% HP he uses his last two abilities which are the totems.

creator: nocturne
statement: Healing Totem heals him 750000 HP every few seconds on Chaotic.

creator: nocturne
statement: Shield Totem occasionally puts up a shield on either the bottom or upper half.

creator: nocturne
statement: Run up and kill the Health Totem quickly; then it does not heal him and no more totems spawn even if he goes above 7.5 million HP.

creator: nocturne
statement: With enough damage you can ignore the Healing Totem.

creator: nocturne
statement: You cannot ignore the Shield Totem because it reduces all your damage to 10 per swing.

creator: nocturne
statement: Totems do not spawn very frequently so with some damage he is fairly easy to kill.

creator: nocturne
statement: He has a chance of dropping the Chaotic Amarok Card.

creator: nocturne
statement: Normal drop tables include Silver

creator: nocturne
statement: Grandma's Disguise is a Wisdom helmet with 1 in 250 drop chance on Chaotic

creator: nocturne
statement: He can drop the Amarok Obol

creator: nocturne
statement: Chaotic Amarok Slabs are required to craft the Amarok Pendant at 4 per pendant and drop 1 in 5.

creator: nocturne
statement: You may have to kill him several times to craft the pendant.
